identity.name: Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise
identity.publisher: Wolters Kluwer (Lippincott Williams & Wilkins), for the American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM)
identity.source_note: Live presentation page journals.lww.com/acsm-msse/pages/informationforauthors.aspx returned HTTP 402; encoded from the canonical Editorial Manager Instructions for Authors page https://edmgr.ovid.com/msse/accounts/ifauth.htm via headless render (Apify rag-web-browser), which returned the full current guide (HTTP 200).

encoding_notes: Publisher is Wolters Kluwer/LWW on behalf of ACSM; no migration found. Canonical guide is the Editorial Manager ifauth.htm page (journals.lww.com presentation page 402-blocked, edmgr.ovid.com rendered clean via headless).

Article-type mapping: Original Investigations->original_research; Clinical Investigations (subtype of original research, no separate slot); Case Studies->case_report; Brief Reviews->review (narrative expert reviews); Systematic and Meta-analytic Reviews->systematic_review; Methodological Advances->technical_note; Letters to the Editor-in-Chief->letter. Omitted (no clean slot): Symposium Proceedings (invited, <=20 pages), Contrasting Perspectives (invited Pro/Con 1500 words each).

SCHEMA GAP - combined figure+table cap: 'No Sweat Submissions' limits figures and tables to EIGHT (8) TOTAL combined at initial submission (e.g., 6 figures + 2 tables), not 8 of each; the per-type figures_max/tables_max fields cannot express a combined cap, so both left null.

SCHEMA GAP - figure DPI is tiered and internally inconsistent: Order-of-Manuscript figures bullet says 'at least 1200 dpi'; Technical figures section says black-and-white line art 900-1200 dpi, combination/grayscale 600-900 dpi, photographs/CT/radiographs at least 300 dpi. min_dpi set to 300 (lowest stated floor, for photographs); higher tiers apply to line art and combination art.
SCHEMA GAP - reviews use a PAGE limit not a word limit: Brief Reviews max 30 double-spaced pages excluding references; Symposium papers <=20 pages. manuscript_max_words left null for review.

SCHEMA GAP - et al truncation: guide says list ALL authors if fewer than 7; when 7 or more authors, list only the FIRST THREE then et al. et_al_threshold set to 6 (truncation triggers at 7+ authors), but truncated lists show first 3 authors, not first 6.

references_max is per-type: 70 for original investigations, 100 for review articles (applied to review and systematic_review), 8 for letters; references.max_count left null because there is no single journal-wide cap.

include_doi set false: the canonical print journal-article reference example carries no DOI; DOIs appear only in the e-journal and preprint reference examples (NLM/Citing Medicine style, Index Medicus abbreviations).
In-text citations are baseline (parenthetical) numeric, e.g. (14,15), explicitly NOT superscript; references numbered in order of citation.
page_size left null: guide specifies 1-inch margins all sides and Times Roman 12pt but never states page size (US-based journal; not inferred per accuracy rules).

Font/spacing/margins/line-numbers are drawn from the 'Revised Manuscripts' formatting requirement (Times Roman 12pt, 1" margins all sides, double-spaced, continuous line numbers); initial 'No Sweat Submissions' are format-flexible but must include line numbers and title page + abstract + IMRAD.

Declarations: 'Conflicts of Interest and Source of Funding' section placed after Acknowledgments and must contain two ACSM disclaimers (results presented honestly / no ACSM endorsement); Data Availability Statement required and verified as a condition of publication; ethics-committee approval and informed-consent statements are mandatory but placed in the Methods section (marked required though not in the end-of-paper declarations block; conditional on human/animal studies).

Abstract: 275-word limit, no reference citations permitted, structured (Purpose/Methods/Results/Conclusions). Keywords: 4-6, alphabetical order, must not repeat title terms; letter case and separator unspecified.
Title max 150 characters including spaces; running (short) title max 45 characters including spaces.

Tables uploaded as separate Word files (Insert Table feature, legend inside file); figures uploaded as separate .tif or .eps files (jpeg/gif/PDF/Word-embedded not accepted); figure legends listed together on a page following the references section.
